RK International CP-42 Two Step Foot Rectangular Pull

text.description_html:
RK International CP-42, Two Step Mount 1920's Jazz Club Pull

The Roaring Twenties were known for swing, jazz, and definitely glamor; and if you think the glitz of 1920's style decor is the bee's knees, than the Jazz Club Cabinet Pull is going to leave your feather in a knot. It is available in 7 finishes, though we have to admit we're head-over-heels for this 3 inch Cabinet Pull in polished brass. The gold color really brings out its vintage beauty. However, the other available finish choices including the ever-popular satin nickel and the just as swanky black are also great choices. More so than the finish, the unique shape of the Two Step Jazz Club Solid Brass Cabinet Pull is what truly gives it its character. Just install it with the packaged hardware, and let the retro style take you back in time.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-42 3" Two Step Foot Rectangular Pull:

  • Material: Brass
  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Overall Length: 4-1/8"
  • Width: 9/16"
  • Projection: 1-1/16"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
